headline: Chippanee Golf Course escrow agreement consent and a $35,000 contract with Avila Technologies for an AI grant platform.
summary: The seller, FW Blasius, Jr. LLC, asked the city to consent to assigning the escrow agreement. The contract item would let the Mayor or Acting Mayor sign, and it is referred to the Office of Corporation Counsel for review.
items: Consent to collateral assignment of escrow agreement, Chippanee Golf Facility, requested by seller FW Blasius, Jr. LLC
Authorize the Mayor or Acting Mayor to sign a $35,000 contract with Avila Technologies Inc. for an AI grant platform subscription, referred to the Office of Corporation Counsel for review
location: Council Chambers, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT 06010

2. Chippanee Golf Course 
 a. Consent to Collateral Assignment of Escrow Agreement, Chippanee Golf Facility, as
